notes.title: New update adds Player Profiles
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33403719/b1a0c328b51db11db54962e2ae7ce528ed1c66ad.png[/img]

We're happy to release our new update to Shahrzad – The Storyteller! 

This patch adds a feature that has been requested by the community: you can now create and manage multiple profiles!
In addition, the new version also addresses a few gameplay glitches that have been reported. In detail, the main changes in this version are:

[list]
[*]added Profile Management
[*]fixed a bug that restarted Music when entering a new stage even when set to off
[*]fixed a bug which kept the game from progressing
[*]fixed an invisible item
[*]fixed some spelling issues
[*]fixed some graphic glitches
[*]various smaller bug fixes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the game more than ever!
